useCase: Preliminary screening for AI生成の content and post-processing 検出
mechanism: Bypassing biological optical sight completely. It violently pulverizes the image canvas into a bar-graph tracking intensity from 0 (Pitch Black) to 255 (Blinding White). Complete amateurs maliciously copying cars or clipping foliage to dump them into alien sunsets notice severe color clashes, frantically grabbing the 'Levels' slider, forcefully tearing the luminosity apart to fake optical depth. Inside digital matrix mathematics, violently stretching a finite, organic luminous continuum literally tears the data fabric in half! The severed void registers as a dead zone (Gaps), and the hyper-stressed bunched-up pixels violently deform into swelling blights (Spikes). This algorithm exhaustively audits that microscopic debris to sentence the fraudster to the executioner's block.
accuracy: 中 - 70-82%（単独手法として、他の信号と組み合わせると向上）
name: ヒストグラム分析
algorithm: マルチチャネルヒストグラム分析
parameters: Bins: 256, Channels: R/G/B/L, Metrics: kurtosis, skewness, エントロピー, gap count, periodicity index
description: 分析します color and luminance ヒストグラム 分布s for 統計的 異常. AI生成の images often show unnaturally smooth or periodic ヒストグラム パターン.

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Statistical Tools for Digital Forensics. Information Hiding.
McCloskey, S. & Albright, M. (2019). Detecting GAN-generated Imagery using Saturation Cues. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Very fast computation
• Effective preliminary screening tool
• 検出します common AI ヒストグラム パターン
• Works にわたる all image formats
limitations:
• Low standalone 検出 rate
• Post-processing easily alters ヒストグラムs
• Natural images can have unusual ヒストグラムs
• Color-corrected images produce 誤検出
